tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description: Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
The Bidder shall have experience in similar services in in the business or activity of development and/or any construction activities, Business or Convention Centers, Institutions in the last 5 years
Achieved in, at least any two financial years a financial turnover of Rs. 16.00 Crores in last 5 years

Mandating satisfactorily completion as prime contractor for at least one similar work such as Providing Design, Build, Finance, Operate and Transfer of Skywalk value not less than Rs.4.00 Crore Usually not less than 50% of the cost of work) in the last five years period i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26 (Updated to the financial years in which the tenders are invited. The value of the completed works shall be given weight of 10% per year to bring them to the price level of the financial year in which the Tenders are invited)

Executed in any one year, the following minimum quantities of work in the last five years period i.e., 2021-22 to 2025-26- Providing Design, Build, Finance, Operate and Transfer of Skywalk at least 1 Nos of single structure of length 80m

Demonstration In order to ensure meeting of Specification requirements, as a part of evaluation of Technical Bids, the Bidders should demonstrate through proper documentary evidence to the satisfaction of BWCC. Demonstration location will be in Bangalore, date, timing and venue will be informed by the tender authority after bid opening

If the bidder is not registered in BWCC/GBA/BBMP, should register with BWCC/GBA/BBMP advertisement department once tender is awarded and shall follow all the Advertisement Bye Laws, Rules and Circulars of the BWCC in this regard

The Bidder shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for corrupt or fraudulent practices and should not be blacklisted or banned or debarred by any state government or central government or police department or PSUs in India
Bidder shall enclose trained staff details for the above work
Bidder should issue a statement undertaking total responsibility for the defect free operation of the Skywalks during the operation and maintenance period
The bidder shall take No due certificate from GBA, BBMP for any pending arrears of revenue sharing or ground rent which had to be paid for GBA, BBMP

The bidder shall give an undertaking form for that the bidder will cover all the incidental charges occurring for preparation of this tender such as detailed design, soil studies, cost estimation, DPR and not expect GBA to cover the cost
All the other conditions as per RFP document.
